title: 第5章 残诀之威第6章 老奸巨猾的长老
slug: 太古神族第2477章秘境之变
lines: 在藏书阁内的莫阳根本不知道外面发生的一切，他一连翻看了近十本古籍，只是压根就没有找到丝毫有关星皇的记载。
漫漫岁月中，仿若就从没有这么一个人存在过一样。
不过他也并非一无所获。
在翻看古籍时无意中发现了一套残缺的剑法，只是残缺的很严重，只剩下一层的心法。
“他怎么会选中那本残卷，那剑法残缺太厉害，而且心诀过于玄奥，根本无法修炼！”
太上长老皱眉轻语，因为莫阳在藏书阁中的举动他看得一清二楚。
“咦，这小子……难道其他功法他都看不上眼吗，怎么就这么出来了？”太上长老接着皱眉。
几位长老藏身于暗中，看着莫阳从藏书阁走出，莫阳丝毫没有停留，直接朝着木峰的方向走去。
只是在即将离开几位长老视线范围的时候，莫阳居然回头朝着几位长老的藏身之处看了一眼。
似是有意，又像是无意。
“莫非他发现我们了！”
大长老低声惊呼，随即连忙收敛了气息。
“他才地玄境一阶，灵觉居然这么敏锐！”二长老也压低声音惊呼。
“应该没发现，不过这小家伙倒是越来越让人看不透了……”太上长老右手不自觉的捋了捋胡须。
说话间微微点头，嘴角居然浮起一抹笑意。
随后几人都暗中离开了，原本是为苏菲儿的事情来，要找莫阳算账，但直接被太上长老阻止了。
大长老和二长老虽然看莫阳不顺眼，但也只能忍下来。
莫阳回到木峰后，直接进入石塔中，开始参悟藏书阁得来的剑法，那短短几句口诀他已经熟记在心。
莫阳之所以看中这套剑法，只是因为那口诀异常晦涩拗口，一看就不像普通剑法。
因为他修炼的星皇经就与之相类似。
一直修炼到夜幕降临，莫阳还是没有头绪，只不过不知不觉间，他的修为居然增长了不少。
经脉中流转的真气壮大了一圈，已经渐渐靠近地玄境一阶中期了。
莫阳不得不感叹，星皇经确实非凡，照这样的速度，要不了几天，他就能突破到地玄境二阶，这种修炼速度放在那些大势力中只怕也会惊掉一地下巴。
而他压根不知道，此时灵虚宗，已经因他闹得沸沸扬扬了。
因为有不少弟子看到苏菲儿从木峰上哭哭啼啼的冲下去，衣裙都被撕破了几道口子，满头的长发凌乱不堪，那等模样自然让那些弟子产生了诸多猜测。
各种猜测不断在众弟子间流传，那些苏菲儿的仰慕者彻底炸开了锅。
只是让众弟子不解的是，宗门的一群长老居然一句也没有过问……
像是完全不知道一样！
而苏菲儿本人却彻底懵了，那些传闻尚且还好，让她想不通的是，当日晚间她去找太上长老时，太上长老居然半点没有要处罚莫阳的意思。
言语间反而是让她多和莫阳接触，只顾一个劲夸莫阳好。
言外之意再明显不过。
第二日，灵虚宗的第一天骄齐衡修炼出关，身为主峰的大师兄，他此番闭关数月，修为突破到了地玄境一阶。
听到那些传闻后，齐衡勃然大怒。
他本想直接杀上木峰，但从其他弟子口中得知莫阳前几日的事情，一番思索之后，他让人给莫阳送去了一封挑战书。
木峰上，莫阳坐在小院中的石凳上，看着手中那封挑战书，整个人也有些懵……
因为上面只有时间和地点以及齐衡的名字，莫阳完全不知道罪魁祸首竟然是苏菲儿。
“齐衡……年轻人好胜心就是强……”
content_en:
Mo Yang, who was in the library, had no idea what was happening outside. He read nearly ten ancient books in a row, but he couldn't find any records about the Star Emperor.
Throughout the years, it was as if such a person had never existed.
But he didn't gain anything.
While looking through ancient books, I accidentally discovered a set of incomplete sword techniques, but the defects were very serious, leaving only a layer of mental techniques.
"How could he choose that fragment of a scroll? The sword technique is too incomplete and the inner skills are too mysterious to be practiced at all!"
The Supreme Elder frowned and whispered, because he could clearly see Mo Yang's actions in the library.
"Hey, this kid...doesn't he look down on other techniques? Why did he come out like this?" The elder Taishang then frowned.
…
Several elders hid in the dark and watched Mo Yang walk out of the library. Mo Yang didn't stop at all and walked directly in the direction of Mu Feng.
Just when he was about to leave the sight of the elders, Mo Yang actually turned back and glanced at the hiding place of the elders.
It seems intentional, but also unintentional.
"Maybe he found us!"
The great elder exclaimed in a low voice, and then quickly restrained his breath.
"He is only at the first level of the Earthly Profound Realm, but his spiritual sense is so sharp!" The second elder also lowered his voice and exclaimed.
"I probably didn't notice it, but this little guy is becoming more and more difficult to see through..." The Supreme Elder unconsciously stroked his beard with his right hand.
He nodded slightly as he spoke, and a smile actually appeared on the corner of his mouth.
Then several people left secretly. They originally came because of Sophie's matter and wanted to settle accounts with Mo Yang, but they were directly stopped by the Supreme Elder.
Although the First Elder and the Second Elder didn't like Mo Yang, they could only endure it.
After Mo Yang returned to Mufeng, he directly entered the stone tower and began to study the sword skills obtained from the Library Pavilion. He had memorized those few formulas by heart.
The reason why Mo Yang fell in love with this set of swordsmanship was because the formula was extremely obscure and difficult to pronounce, and it didn't look like ordinary swordsmanship at first glance.
Because the Star Emperor Sutra he practiced was similar to it.
After practicing until nightfall, Mo Yang still had no clue, but unknowingly, his cultivation level actually increased a lot.
The true energy flowing in the meridians has grown in strength, and it is gradually approaching the middle stage of the first level of the Earthly Profound Realm.
Mo Yang had to sigh, the Star Emperor Sutra was indeed extraordinary. At this speed, he would be able to break through to the second level of the Earth Profound Realm in a few days. This kind of cultivation speed would probably make those big forces shocked.
But he had no idea that Lingxu Sect was already making a fuss because of him.
Because many disciples saw Sophie rushing down from the wooden peak crying, her clothes were torn in several holes, and her long hair was messy. Her appearance naturally made those disciples make many guesses.
Various speculations continued to circulate among the disciples, and Sophie's admirers completely exploded.
What puzzled the disciples was that a group of elders from the sect didn’t even say a word...
It’s like I don’t know at all!
But Sophie herself was completely confused. Those rumors were okay, but what she couldn't figure out was that when she went to see the Supreme Elder that night, the Supreme Elder had no intention of punishing Mo Yang at all.
Instead, the words asked her to have more contact with Mo Yang and just kept praising Mo Yang.
The implication could not be more obvious.
On the second day, Qi Heng, the first genius of the Lingxu Sect, came out of seclusion. As the senior brother of the main peak, he had been in seclusion for several months and his cultivation had broken through to the first level of the Earthly Profound Realm.
After hearing those rumors, Qi Heng became furious.
He originally wanted to kill Mu Feng directly, but he learned about Mo Yang's events a few days ago from other disciples. After some thought, he had someone send a letter of challenge to Mo Yang.
On the wooden peak, Mo Yang sat on the stone bench in the small courtyard, looking at the challenge letter in his hand, he was also a little confused...
Because there was only the time, place and Qi Heng's name on it, Mo Yang had no idea that the culprit turned out to be Sophie.
"Qi Heng... young people are very competitive..."
